title: Great God Grove
tagline: Every card is an achievement. Tick it when it pops in-game; the route underneath is the short path to that one achievement.
order_note: Sections run in walkthrough order — Grove Cove, Milldread, HobbyHoo, BuzzHuzz, then the finale — and achievements sit where the walkthrough describes them popping. A few miscellaneous ones (the rabbits, the beach ball, the videos) are placed at the walkthrough moment that triggers them; chapter-end achievements may pop slightly earlier or later than listed.
scope_note: All 42 achievements / 1,000G — the full game. One playthrough covers everything if you use the cloud-save trick for the two deputy answers in Chapter 1; completed chapters can also be replayed from their start.

achievements.name: I have arrived
achievements.how: Finish the opening on The Hauzer: grab the four anchors with the Megapon and watch the cutscene.

achievements.name: him
achievements.how: After landing, interact with the black bunny on the left of the entrance gate.

achievements.name: INSPEKTA
achievements.how: Go through the lit door into the van and meet Inspekta.

achievements.name: Shaboingboings
achievements.how: Shoot the BizzyBoy blocking the bridge with 'Lay off and take a snack break! That's an order'.

achievements.name: H-h-h-historian
achievements.req: Y-you really l-love hearing a bookish g-girl ramble, huh?
achievements.how: Keep the historian by the riverbank dry with the Megapon while you talk through all her dialogue.

achievements.name: MISS MITTERNACHT
achievements.how: Clear the wood from the yellow-glowing door and meet Miss Mitternacht inside.

achievements.name: Da Rift an' You
achievements.req: Watch the first video by the BizzyBoys
achievements.how: Across the repaired bridge, use the front TV in the cluster and watch the first BizzyBoy video — it pops when you exit the screen.

achievements.name: Godwhisperer
achievements.how: Cheer her up: deliver Razzmatazz's line, then 'With the power of communication, I can bring the gods together!', and answer yes.

achievements.name: Good Little Deputy
achievements.how: At the end of the chapter, answer yes to staying Inspekta's deputy. Use the cloud-save trick — quit, delete only the local save, reload — to get both deputy answers in one run.

achievements.name: Skeptical of authority
achievements.how: At the end of the chapter, answer no to staying Inspekta's deputy (see the cloud-save note on Good Little Deputy).

achievements.name: Milldread
achievements.req: Reach the town of perpetual sunset
achievements.how: Follow the path up from Grove Cove into the town.
Take 'I thought this place had barbeque, WHERE'S THE SMOKED HOG?' from Capochin and shoot it at the pig by the brush.

achievements.name: Da God Awards
achievements.req: Watch the second video by the BizzyBoys
achievements.how: In the bakery, use the TV on the right and watch the second BizzyBoy video.

achievements.name: him again
achievements.how: Inside the bakery, interact with the rabbit on the right side.

achievements.name: COBIGAIL
achievements.req: Meet the God of the Harvest
achievements.how: Clear the bookshelf in the school's back room and meet Cobigail.

achievements.name: Master barber
achievements.how: Take 'GET A HAIRCUT!' from Capochin in the school and shoot it back at him.

achievements.name: Too far
achievements.how: Run the insult chain between Capochin and Razzmatazz to the end — the final insult, delivered to Razzmatazz, pops it.

achievements.name: Bloodletting
achievements.req: Teach Milldread the meaning of the Harvest
achievements.how: Stop the sacrifice: give Cobigail the Milldread Berry, have the Bayker make jam from it, then shoot Saul with the jam.

achievements.name: ...Bless you.
achievements.how: After the sacrifice is stopped, take the Bayker's 'ACCHOOOOO!' and shoot it anywhere.

achievements.name: Justice Served
achievements.how: Clear the first BizzyBoy battle on the path out of Milldread.

achievements.name: HobbyHoo
achievements.how: Follow the path up from Milldread into the hills.

achievements.name: THESPIUS
achievements.how: Enter the tent with the glowing yellow door and meet Thespius.

achievements.name: A Bedtime Tail
achievements.req: Watch the third video by the BizzyBoys
achievements.how: In Clicky Tower, use the TV and watch the third BizzyBoy video.

achievements.name: CLICK CLACK
achievements.how: In Clicky Tower, find Click Clack and shoot him with 'Whoof, I think it's time for some editing.'

achievements.name: Reprimanded
achievements.how: Apologise to Styella with her two phrases, in order: the 'sahry for callin' yoah face ugly' line, then the 'piece of human gahbage' line.

achievements.name: him again again
achievements.how: Above Byoolah, interact with the third rabbit.

achievements.name: ...chill out
achievements.how: In the Soul Cricket, shoot Capochin with 'NO MORE CAPO! TIME TO SEIZE THE MEANS OF DEDUCTION!'

achievements.name: A test of Patience
achievements.req: Listen to an entire story from Patience
achievements.how: In the Soul Cricket, listen to Patience's whole story, and confirm you're still listening when she asks.

achievements.name: From the top
achievements.req: Give HobbyHoo a performance for the ages
achievements.how: Finish the stage performance: purple bulb in the switch, the Episode XIV script to Hersha, then watch from the audience pillows.

achievements.name: Double Date
achievements.req: Confess a crush to the storyteller god
achievements.how: After the performance, take Daffodil's 'I'm HAM-HOT for a handsome god!' to Click Clack and pick another god as your date.

achievements.name: BuzzHuzz
achievements.how: Follow the path from HobbyHoo into the plaza.

achievements.name: Irresponsible babysitter
achievements.req: Fed the beach ball to Alexei again
achievements.how: Feed Alexei the beach ball again — he lounges under the umbrella by the sandbags.

achievements.name: Telltail
achievements.how: In Bauhauzzo's room, shoot him with 'GETSCRAMLOSTGONE!'

achievements.name: BAUHAUZZO
achievements.how: Leave Bauhauzzo's room after the alley-phrase exchange.

achievements.name: Order Orderer
achievements.how: Shoot Bananathaniel with Bauhauzzo's 'I order you to open this alley!' and play out his dialogue.

achievements.name: HUZZLE MUG
achievements.how: Enter the glowing door in the alley and meet Huzzle Mug.

achievements.name: Prom queen
achievements.req: Give the god of invention a corsage
achievements.how: Shoot Huzzle Mug with the Azure Rose and say yes to the Promdance.

achievements.name: Mrow
achievements.how: Catch the Pink Herring jumping from the pool and shoot it at Veronicat.

achievements.name: Cookin' wit da Capo
achievements.how: In the BizzyBoy Barracks, use the TV and watch Capochin's homemade video.

achievements.name: traitor
achievements.how: In the BizzyBoy Barracks, interact with the bunny beside the TV.

achievements.name: VIVA LA REVOLUTION
achievements.how: Finish the plaza: uniform on the statue model, then 'NO USELESS GODS. ONE LEADER'S PLENTY!' at the statue base to open the top.

sections.title: Chapter 5 · The End of the Line
sections.subtitle: 1 achievement

achievements.name: KING
achievements.how: After the teleport in the finale, walk forward and meet The King.
